query: A Room That Was Turning Two tables in the refectory are on the edge of a food fight, and every head is turning. It's the Newt all over again, with worse gravy. Step in and turn it One joke about the gravy, at exactly the right moment, and both tables laugh instead of throwing it. The prefects look relieved and slightly suspicious. Your heart doesn't slow down until bed. Let it happen You let it go, and the food fight is magnificent. You watch from under the table, laughing. Nobody remembers it was nearly stopped.
